blocks.text: Subscriptions define the various Internet & SaaS (ZIA) features and levels of functionality that are available to your organization. In the Zscaler Admin Console, you can view the features subscribed to your account. The Subscriptions page lists the information that is applicable to your admin accounts.
Contact your Zscaler Account team to update your subscriptions. To learn more, see Zscaler Pricing and Plans and Ranges & Limitations.
Subscriptions provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: View the various features and levels of functionality that are available to your organization.
View the information that is applicable to your admin accounts.

blocks.text: On the Subscriptions page (Administration > Subscription > Internet & SaaS), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Modify the table and its columns.
View a list of the features and levels of functionality that are available to your organization:
Name: The name of the subscription.
SKU: The SKU of the subscription.
Status: The status of the subscription (i.e., Subscribed or Trial). You can filter the table results by Status.
Usage: The number of users accessing subscription licenses.
Licenses: The number of licenses for the subscription.
Start Date: The date when the subscription was enabled.
End Date: The date when the subscription expires.
